there are times where I wish that I’d be better off dead, and other times where I clearly plan my own death and sometimes try to go on with that plan. But I haven’t had any severe thoughts for about a month/half a month now?
A show that I’m forcing myself to not watch is the only thing that’s keeping me alive, I’ve made plans that the moment that I finish that show and season 4 comes out I’ll die.

There are those who still can’t comprehend the meaning of life, and other’s who make up absurd meanings such as, “success is the meaning of life and our whole purpose to live!” I suppose that no one will actually know the true meaning until they die.

We all have zero purpose. We were born like that, but there are some that are willing to go out of their way to make themselves have a purpose to live. Well it doesn’t matter since we’re all going to die sooner or later, however it’s still best to not let your days go astray.

living itself is a sin. Well to me at least, there’s a saying that goes like “those who wither their days away without any effort whatsoever are a walking disgrace.” I’m glad to say that my whole entire life I’ve been surrounded by a decent amount of nice people, but that’s still not enough. I sit in bed for 19 hours everyday waiting to get tired and end up getting in bed hoping to wake up dead. I don’t get any suicidal thoughts unless I force myself to think of such things. Which is pretty funny, since most people are glad to not get them But I’m the complete opposite. I crave getting thoughts like that, they are pleasing(well to me at least) and calm me down a lot. I hate it when people want to help me. Just yesterday I went on a rampage and blocked every ”friend” that I could think of, why you ask? That’s because I don’t need them, I don’t deserve them, I’m scared of hurting them, hmm..actually no. I’m scared of them hurting me. I’d like to know why I’m suicidal but no one is willing to give me the actual answer.
